messages:
lauren_sales: Quick one — Stella (StellarPay) is ready to start a 30-day POC. They want a hosted API key we can issue that is short-lived, IP-restricted to their NAT egress, and easy for us to rotate/revoke if needed. Any blockers from security or ops?

stella_customer: Confirming — we'll provide 3 egress IPs and prefer a 30-day TTL. Also need assurance keys can be revoked immediately and that usage is auditable.

miguel_se: Cool. We can create a scoped hosted key limited to generation + embeddings and add IP allowlist. Recommend 30d TTL for initial POC, but suggest rotating weekly for security — we can automate rotation if you want.

anya_security: @lauren_sales a few checks: keys must be scope-limited, audit logs enabled for all token ops, and revocation should be immediate with a clear owner. Also ask the customer if they need MFA for the console user that views keys.

lauren_sales: They don't need console access, only service key usage. We'll be the owner. Stella will supply IPs. Can we include rate limits to protect quota?

miguel_se: Yes. When we create the key we can attach a policy: { allowed_routes: ["/v1/generate","/v1/embeddings"], rps_limit: 20, monthly_quota_tokens: 500000 }. I'll draft the policy.

oliver_devex: For ops, here's the standard CLI flow I use. Paste the key in their CI as a secret. Rotation script (example):

```
# create new key
redwoodctl keys create --name "stellar-poc-2026-03" --scopes generate,embeddings --ttl 30d --ip-allowlist 203.0.113.5,203.0.113.6,203.0.113.7 --policy-file poc-policy.json
# swap CI secret to new key
# revoke old key
redwoodctl keys revoke --id KEY_ID
```

oliver_devex: We also log all create/revoke in the control-plane audit log (retention default 90d for POC).

anya_security: Two more items: 1) make sure the key is marked as "ephemeral" with an explicit expiry so expired keys are auto-blocked, 2) we need the customer to approve storing usage metadata (IP + request headers) for troubleshooting.

stella_customer: Approve storing request metadata for troubleshooting only. TTL 30d is fine; weekly rotation optional — prefer once we see stability.

miguel_se: OK I'll provision a key with 30d TTL, IP allowlist, scoped routes, and a monthly quota. I'll attach the audit tag `poc:stellarpay-2026-03`. We'll generate one and send the secret via the secure link.

lauren_sales: Thanks. Please also add a revocation playbook in the message so customer knows steps if their CI is compromised.

miguel_se: Revocation playbook (short):
1) mark key as revoked in console or run `redwoodctl keys revoke --id <KEY_ID>`
2) rotate CI secrets to new key immediately
3) if secrets leaked externally, open incident and we will run a retrospective; we can also disable the POC project in 1 click

deploy-bot: key.create event for key id k_3g7f9 (user: miguel_se)

lauren_sales: Miguel — once you create it, post the `secure_link` here and I'll DM Stella the access. Also cc @anya_security with the audit log link.

miguel_se: Will do. Creating now; expect secure link in ~10m.

deploy-bot: key.revoke event for key id k_old123 (user: miguel_se)

miguel_se: Done — created key id k_3g7f9, TTL 30d, scoped, IPs set. Secure link: https://redwood.example/securekeys/redirect/k_3g7f9 (link expires in 24h). Audit: https://console.redwood.example/audit?tag=poc:stellarpay-2026-03

lauren_sales: Sent to Stella via DM. Stella: confirm you received the secure link and that your dev can validate connectivity.

stella_customer: Received and validated — token works from our allowed egress. Running baseline tests now. Thanks all! :tada:

anya_security: Verified audit entry and revocation path. Marking security ack for POC.

miguel_se: Follow-up: we'll schedule a rotation reminder at 7d and 21d before expiry. If customer asks, we can move to weekly rotation automation.

lauren_sales: Great. Closing this thread. Keep me posted on any quota bumps. :thumbsup:
